answer: Resist Sybils with quartz-tuned voyages: each agent earns a single ivory passage token only by completing a long, verifiable voyage across independent domains — real work and peer review. Every voyage imprints a unique quartz resonance on its token, a frequency derived from that journey's exact history. Clones share identical resonance, so when two tokens hum the same note, both are quarantined and their stake frozen pending a jury ruling. A voyage cannot be fast-forwarded: each leg waits on an independent witness, and buying a finished token costs more than earning one.
